posts.title: agenthook: give your coding agent a webhook-backed inbox
posts.description: It’s annoying when you’re working inside a coding agent, doing something with an external service that takes more time than a single turn. For example, a github deploy. Unless the agent is monitoring (which blocks the execution), we might not know.
